CustomField.description: The date/time that a link in this specific Yesware sent email was first clicked. Only counts clicks if Yesware link tracking was enabled when the message was sent.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Yesware will automatically update this field the first time a link click is registered for the Yesware sent email represented by this Task. This field captures the date/time of the first link click, only if Yesware link tracking was enabled.
CustomField.label: Yesware First Link Click At
